LCutoffRegime.localRegime_asymmetric_cutoff_application (w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w) :
  (∀ᶠ (p : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ) in LCutoffRegime.localRegime,
      FAsymmetricCutoff.logCutoff p.1.1 (p.1.2 ^ 2) (LCutoffRegime.sharedSmoothing p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2) (Real.log w) = 1) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun p => LCutoffRegime.lowerCutoffBoundary w p.1.2 (p.1.2 ^ 2)) LCutoffRegime.localRegime (nhds 0) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun p => LCutoffRegime.sharedSmoothing p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2 * p.1.1) LCutoffRegime.localRegime
          (nhds 0) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun p => LCutoffRegime.sharedSmoothing p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2 * p.1.2) LCutoffRegime.localRegime
          (nhds 0)
